executive_summary.business_impact: The application exposes sensitive credentials and configuration data that could lead to account takeover and unauthorized access.
strengths: Application uses allowlist for redirect validation
challenges: Sensitive credentials exposed in client-side configuration
strategic_recommendations: Implement authentication for all admin endpoints

findings.title: Sensitive Information Disclosure - Application Configuration and OAuth Credentials Exposed
findings.summary: The application exposes sensitive configuration data including OAuth credentials and security question answers via an unauthenticated administrative endpoint, enabling account takeover attacks.
findings.description: The application exposes sensitive configuration information through the `/rest/admin/application-configuration` endpoint without authentication. This endpoint reveals Google OAuth Client ID, security question answers, and complete application configuration data.

exposed_data: Security Question Answers: Daniel Boone National Forest, ITsec
technical_details.impact: Attackers can harvest OAuth credentials for phishing attacks, bypass account security questions to reset passwords and take over accounts, and gather reconnaissance information about the application architecture.
technical_details.testing_process: Accessed the /rest/admin/application-configuration endpoint directly without authentication and observed that it returned complete application configuration including sensitive credentials and security answers.

recommendations: Remove sensitive credentials from client-side configuration endpoints
Implement authentication and authorization checks for admin configuration endpoints
Remove security question answers from public-facing configuration
